USDC is a fiat-collateralized stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. USDC is issued by Circle. USDC runs on public blockchains such as Ethereum.

Synthetix is a decentralized protocol for synthetic assets. Synthetix uses SNX as collateral for issuing synthetic assets. Synthetix is built on smart contracts on public blockchains.

yearn finance is a yield aggregator that automates strategies for DeFi yield generation. yearn finance operates through vaults that users deposit assets into. yearn finance is built on smart contracts on public blockchains.

USDT is a fiat-collateralized stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. USDT is issued by Tether Limited. USDT runs on multiple public blockchains.
